headline: A handcrafted Italian leather bag she will never forget
body: Made in Florence for a monumental milestone. This custom-fit leather handbag arrives with premium presentation worthy of your most important recipient.
rationale: This ad targets the Gifter persona by focusing heavily on the impressiveness of a major milestone gift, leaning into Florence craftsmanship as a signifier of quality without mentioning discounts, aligning with their low price sensitivity and desire for premium presentation.
